Filed correctly by Marvel Consultants.
- [GST returns and ongoing compliance in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/gst-returns-compliance/index.md): Monthly, quarterly and annual GST compliance for Bengaluru businesses: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 and 9C, ITC reconciliation with GSTR-2B, e-invoicing and e-way bills, and a compliance calendar that keeps notices away. Marvel Consultants manages the rhythm.
- [GST notices and replies in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/gst-notices/index.md): Received a GST notice in Bengaluru? Marvel Consultants reads it the same day, explains what it demands and by when, and prepares the reply with the reconciliation to support it — scrutiny (ASMT-10), intimation (DRC-01A), show-cause notices under sections 73 and 74, ITC mismatch, audit and summons.
- [GST appeals and litigation in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/gst-appeals-litigation/index.md): Adverse GST order in Bengaluru? Marvel Consultants files the first appeal (APL-01) within the three-month limit, advises on the pre-deposit, prepares grounds and evidence, and represents you before the appellate authority — and coordinates with counsel for tribunal and court stages.
- [Business and government registrations in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/registrations/index.md): The registrations a business needs to operate in Bengaluru: BBMP trade licence, Karnataka Shops & Establishments, professional tax, MSME/Udyam, PAN/TAN, GST, and support for company, LLP and partnership formation. Marvel Consultants files and renews them.
- [BBMP and BDA building plan approval in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/real-estate/bbmp-plan-approval/index.md): Building plan sanction from BBMP or BDA in Bengaluru: eligibility (Khata, layout approval, road width, zoning), documents, the online application, scrutiny, fees and follow-up to sanction; plan alteration and layout approval. Marvel Consultants manages the government-facing process with your architect.
- [Project compliance and government liaison in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/real-estate/project-compliance-liaison/index.md): Government liaison and compliance for real-estate projects in Bengaluru: BBMP and BDA correspondence, inspections and notices, utility connections and NOCs, Khata and e-Khata for units, property tax assessment and the office follow-up that keeps files moving from commencement to handover.
